## `neuro.date.UTC`

Static method on `Date`.

> Returns the number of milliseconds between midnight, January 1, 1970 Universal Coordinated Time (UTC) (or GMT) and the specified date.

## Signatures

```ts
UTC(input: { year: number; monthIndex: number; date?: number; hours?: number; minutes?: number; seconds?: number; ms?: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
UTC(input: { year: number; monthIndex?: number; date?: number; hours?: number; minutes?: number; seconds?: number; ms?: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Date.UTC` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
